events.text: Supreme Court opens its new term and hears Suncor Energy v. Boulder County.
events.detail: Whether federal law bars state-law lawsuits seeking damages from oil and gas companies for climate change. Justice Alito will not participate.

events.text: Supreme Court hears Genalo v. Black.
events.detail: Whether holding noncitizens in long detention without a bond hearing violates the Constitution.

events.text: Supreme Court hears Salazar v. Paramount Global.
events.detail: How far the Video Privacy Protection Act reaches beyond traditional video providers.
